title: GUIs should be fully keyboard-driven
summary: This opinion piece argues that modern graphical user interfaces should be designed to be fully operable via keyboard, highlighting the productivity and accessibility benefits of keyboard-driven navigation over mouse-centric interactions.
problem_solved: Addresses the common issue of software that requires mouse interaction for basic tasks, limiting efficiency and accessibility for power users and those with mobility impairments.
why_valuable: Advocates for inclusive design that improves productivity, reduces context-switching friction, and makes software accessible to users who cannot use traditional pointing devices.
